# Expert validation: model answer key

*Not shown to the expert. Generated by `make expert`; do not edit by hand.*

Ten fictional cases are scored by the spring model (v2) and the current model (v3.1). The expert sees only the case texts ([`expert_prediction_form.md`](expert_prediction_form.md), in Turkish) and gives a 6-year risk and an action for each; `make expert-analyze` then compares the two.

Actions: **A** routine follow-up, **B** low-dose CT screening, **C** prompt physician assessment. v3 action: prompt assessment advised (NICE NG12 rule, symptom layer of 3 % or more, or haemoptysis) gives C; otherwise a 6-year risk of 1.51 % or more, or a USPSTF screening candidate, gives B; otherwise A. v2 action: high band gives C; moderate band or USPSTF candidate gives B; otherwise A.

All values are per cent. "v3 6y" is the 6-year layer (risk factors only) with its band; the symptom layer is the probability that the current symptoms are due to lung cancer (a dash means no symptom was reported).
